svg.aria-label: Featured engineering projects by Bhavish S

g.text: 01 / NODUE PORTAL
Student NOC clearance and workflow automation system with multi-department sign-offs.
Eliminates campus administrative delays with role-based authorization and cryptographic audit logs.
REACT · TYPESCRIPT · NODE.JS · FIREBASE // DEPLOYED
02 / BUDGET ALLOCATOR
Algorithmic expense distribution and intelligent financial planning engine.
Provides predictive spending models, dynamic budget adjustments, and interactive telemetry dashboards.
PYTHON · JAVASCRIPT · TAILWIND CSS · CHARTS // DEPLOYED
03 / ROUTE RESILIENCE
Fault-tolerant network routing simulation modeling topology resilience under adversarial node failure.
Evaluates packet delivery ratios, automated rerouting convergence, and vulnerability bottlenecks.
PYTHON · NETWORKX · GRAPH SIMULATION // DEPLOYED
04 / NOVIC EVENTS
Campus event ticketing platform featuring cryptographic QR pass validation and live check-in telemetry.
Prevents ticket tampering, tracks attendee flow in real time, and streamlines organizer operations.
REACT · NODE.JS · EXPRESS · MONGODB // DEPLOYED
05 / TACTICAL LAB MATRIX
Interactive gamified cybersecurity training arena and simulation game with live cyber defense challenges.
Tests defensive countermeasures, privilege awareness, and rapid incident response in a game loop.
TYPESCRIPT · THREE.JS · BROWSER CANVAS · CYBERSEC // DEPLOYED
